name: Getac ZX80W-EX
summary: The Getac ZX80W-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 8-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx EPS 25.0039X Current (issue 0); no separate ZX80W-EX certificate found; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
iecex.number: IECEx EPS 25.0039X (ZX80-Exc), assumed to cover the Windows variant

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: As ZX80-Exc: protect from UV and mechanical impact; interfaces never used in hazardous areas; battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; not next to strong charge-generating processes; batteries BP1S1P4060B or BP1S1P4990B.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Same list as ZX80-EX: certificate names hand strap, shoulder strap, digitizer pen and tether. Anti-static screen film for hazardous use. Hand strap with stylus holder, rotating hand strap and vehicle cradle on the datasheet. NOT for hazardous areas: USB-C adapter, vehicle adapter, chargers, batteries.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC (Arm); LTSC 2024 inferred

specs.hotSwap: Headline claims high-capacity hot-swappable batteries (non-hazardous areas only)
specs.ports: USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C (DP, PD), microSD or hybrid nano-SIM tray; optional 1D/2D barcode
specs.keys: Power + 3 programmable (Windows key, volume up, volume down default)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC on Arm; x86 apps need emulation, compatibility not verified)

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Windows on Arm: x86/x64 apps run through emulation and need Arm64 drivers
